I have had a Wahl hair cutting system for over 20 years and still as good as new . I bought the  new  electric razor because I thought the Wahl name still stood for something . Welp this razor is just another product made in China  that cheap and not very good at shaving . Takes for ever to shave and the unit is getting really hot while doing the shaving . Had to stop and let it cool down . As you can see from my pics the original Wahl I bought years ago was made in the USA while this new unit m

In the past, I've shaved with both Norelco rotary and Remington foils.  The foil shaver works best for me so when I decided to start shaving with an electric again, I did a lot of research and read a lot of reviews and decided on purchasing a Wahl Speed Shave Rechargeable Lithium-Ion Wet/Dry Waterproof Facial Hair Shaver.  I get an incredibly close and comfortable shave.  I'm 62 years old and actually enjoy shaving again.  Do not let the low price scare you away.  This is a well-made product.
Great shaver.  As good as my Braun Series 7 Shaver. But 1/6 the cost.  Do you think Braun might be profiteering?

reviews.t: Smooth out of the box... and that's a first!
reviews.x: I hate shaving my whiskers! They're fine, and the beard on my neck lays flat. No matter what shaver I've tried -- Norelco, Remington, even a Braun that I used for year after year, would cause some issue somewhere, or just leave a raggedy patch of missed little hairies. This Wahl (a great name in barbering) felt great out of the box. Smooth, no sense of heads cutting at all, and the shave on my neck was so smooth I think I could have run a cotton ball over it and not snagged one stump of stubble,

I have known of the Wahl brand for a long time. This was the first electric razor I purchased from Wahl. The price was right and the review looked good. Compared to my previous electric razor. The shaver came fully charged. This Wahl shaver gives a very close shave. As close and my manual 4 blade razor. I would recommend this product if you are looking for a new budget electric shaver.
This is a really good shaver it holds a good charge.

I bought this to replace my aging Braun, and I couldn't be happier. It shaves as well as the Braun did when it was new. It shaves smoothly, has a well-built feel, runs pretty quietly, and cleans easily. The battery life is excellent, too.
I get a very cost shave with this electric shaver. It works easily 3x better than I thought it would. I'm still surprised with each shave how good it is.

Wahl should probably stick to making hair clippers! I needed to replace my 6+ year old Remington electric razor and thought I would give this Wahl razor a try. It's a well known brand, but I should have known better, stay with what you know. I received the razor, plugged it in and I'm thinking either the blue (most likely) or red LED should light up. I got the instructions and the blue LED should be on while it's charging and go off when it's finished. I pressed the on button and nothing, not ev
This thing pulls your hair out! Threw it away and got a panisonic

While I've never been a big fan of electric razors, I was tired of the time and effort to shave my head (not to mention the nicks). I went out on a limb and decided to try once more to find a razor that I could use to keep my head shaved. I really like this razor. The pivoting head keeps the blades close as I glide across my skull, the blades cut close reducing the passes it takes to shave an area, and when I'm finished the unit disassembles quickly for easy cleaning. The unit charges fast and s

I don’t even know what to say about this but it’s doesn't shave anything. It’s definitely not for a quick shave. If you have an hr to waste shaving one side of your face go right ahead and order this, if not do not waste your money  The pros to this is that it looks very sleek and make little to no noise which was awesome. Cause normally when my husband starts shaving with his old one I can barely sleep from how noisy it is. So disappointed

I had high hope for this shaver as I own the hair trimmer kit by Wahl and its been stellar..  Pros: (1) Its inexpensive (2) It rechargeable  Cons: (1) It fails at its primary function.. shaving your face. (2) It will not function with the cord plugged in. (3) The slide out beard trimmer is too short and close to the  body of the shaver making it all but impossible to use (4) Subjective... It has a cheap feel.

reviews.t: Finally a nice quality electric razor at a great price
reviews.x: I have had several familiar brand razors in the past 5 years and in my opinion, they are junk. Only one gave a decent shave but the foils were so cheap they only lasted a few months. The other brand that has been around for YEARS, gave me an unbelievably bad shave. Felt like a kid's toy. The solid build quality of this wahl is light years ahead of the others. And the shave is good too. I highly recommend.

Horrific POS that left my face feeling burned and took twice as long as a razor. I bought this for two reasons; saving time and easing the razor burn. This product does neither. My face and in particular neck are in a lot of pain and have a fair amount of hairs left after about 10 minutes.

reviews.t: The best $29 razor you'll ever find
reviews.x: It's not perfect - I still have to touch up a few spots with a blade razor, but it certainly gives a closer shave than I have gotten from some significantly more expensive razors. I think that having two different screen patterns is a good idea, and I like the pop-up trimmer.

reviews.t: GOT TO CLEAN  IT FOR IT TO WORK PROPERLY
reviews.x: Love this shaver shaves as close as a blade and yes it doesn't sometimes but once you clean out the foils (hairs get stuck and need to be cleaned out simple wash out with water) it works just as good as when I bought it cannot recommend this shaver more highly A++
Seemingly never-ending battery life AND closer shave than my Philips Norelco that this Wahl replaced. Brilliant shaver... the battery level is a nice bonus and the cool chrome casing.

After using Braun products for 20+ years and being less and less satisfied with them as the prices kept rising and the quality decreasing, this Wahl shaver was a pleasant surprise. It's just simple, it just works, it's easy to clean, it can go under the faucet, the battery lasts a long time, and there aren't overpriced "cleaning cartridges" to buy for cleaning units that clog up and break down. My 7 series Braun's paint was bubbling up, the replacement foils were expensive and didn't really work

reviews.t: The Wahl mens shaver was complete;y dead  & would not work or even turn on.
reviews.x: Shaver would not turn on, would not charge.  completely dead.  called the wahl company and they just said 'o m ail it back.  Amazon sent me an e-mail saying they had refunded m y purchase price plus postage plus $10 for my trouble I had already thrown the defective shaver away and could  not mail it back.  called Amazon and asked them to take the refund back since I could  no longer mail the item  back..  they said they would not take the refund back but because i had received a defective item

reviews.t: Best electric/rechargeable razor I have ever owned.
reviews.x: I cannot say enough great things about this razor. I have owned many different name brands over the years and the biggest problem has always been that after a couple of days without shaving they were useless. I had to use a blade razor to remove the face hair. The other day I had five days of really solid beard and used the Wahl Speed Shave.To my utter amazement it cut through the beard better than a blade. The battery lasts so long I almost forget to charge it. Anyway, this is a great razor per

reviews.t: This is the one. Great razor for the money!
reviews.x: Good electric razor. I am admitedly not a fan of electruc razors, but for a quick shave or for a first pass before an actual razor this thing is great! Does a passable job day to day, or a great firat pass before a razor shave. I've used it wet and dry, works well both ways. Battery life is super good, using for 5 shaves or more it only uses one "bar" of battery. If you're looking for an electric razor this one is a great value for your money.

After shaving with a blade for 50 years, I finally broke down and decided to try an electric shaver again.  I chose this Wahl because of the perceived value, customer ratings vs. price.  I am CONVINCED!  This shaver gives me the closest shaves ever, with no irritation to even my most sensitive skin, and with much less fuss than a blade.  Everybody on my Christmas list is going to get one.  Highly recommend.

I really wanted to like this.  It shaved moderately well -- esp. for an inexpensive razor.  Unfortunately it failed in 5 months.  The replacement warranty is only 60 days!  The Spanish language manual for other countries says it has a 5 year limited warranty -- but not here.  I suspect that water caused the failure so if you don't use it in the shower, perhaps it will do better.

claims.text: Many reviewers find this razor delivers a close, smooth shave and consider it a great value, often comparing it favorably to pricier brands like Braun.
Several reviewers praise the battery life and that the shaver arrives fully charged.
A notable number of reviewers report the razor fails at shaving, taking too long or not cutting well at all.
Some reviewers complain about poor build quality or defects, including a dead-on-arrival unit and hair pulling.
A few reviewers note disappointment that the product doesn't live up to the Wahl brand's reputation for hair clippers.
